topic: big and small, up and down (opposites)
title: Big and Small, Up and Down with Pip, Lulu, and Bo
yt_description:
Join Pip, Lulu, and Bo to learn about opposites: big and small, up and down. This gentle song helps toddlers recognize size and position through fun and repetition.

🎵 Big and Small, Up and Down with Pip, Lulu, and Bo

Hello, friends! Let's have some fun,
Big and small, we’ll learn as one!

Pip is small and Lulu’s tall,
Big and small, we see them all.

Big and small, up and down,
Look around, see and sound!
Up is high and down is low,
Friends together watch it grow!

Bo climbs up, then slides down,
Up and down, fun all around!

Big and small, up and down,
Look around, see and sound!
Up is high and down is low,
Friends together watch it grow!

Bouncy Meadow — Kids Songs with Pip, Lulu & Bo
Animation and music created with AI tools, written and reviewed by a human.
